description: This is a Java interface defining customer-related services in the sales management system, including methods for retrieving, listing, and updating customer data.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the given first name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all customers associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their nickname.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the customer information; may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers for a store based on specific criteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their nickname within a specific store identified by store ID.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Returns the address for a customer based on the store and IP address, possibly using geo-location services; may throw a ServiceException.
